problem: It says a steady phase error is needed to hold a non-zero V_c, after saying the phase error is zero in an ideal integrator loop. This is contradictory: an integrator (type-II) loop can hold a non-zero V_c with zero steady phase error.
fix: Qualify it: in a simple first-order loop, a steady phase error is needed to hold a non-zero V_c; in an ideal integrator (type-II) loop, the filter can hold V_c with zero steady phase error.

problem: The block diagram has no input/reference signal entering the phase detector. It shows only the feedback from the VCO, so the figure does not match the text and is incomplete.
fix: Add an input node labelled 'Input f_in' and an edge from it to the phase detector.

problem: Saying the capture range is roughly set by the loop-filter cut-off alone is imprecise; capture range also depends on loop gain.
fix: Say it is roughly set by the loop bandwidth, which depends on the loop filter and the loop gain.
